content.short: Aurelius Finance is a decentralized lending protocol and CDP platform on Mantle offering zero-interest stablecoin loans.
content.description:
Aurelius Finance is a decentralized lending protocol and CDP platform on the Mantle Network. It allows users to mint aUSD, a decentralized stablecoin, against collateral like BTC, ETH, and MNT. A standout feature is its zero-interest loan model, enabling users to unlock liquidity from their assets without incurring ongoing interest costs.

To ensure protocol solvency, Aurelius employs a Stability Pool that facilitates the liquidation of under-collateralized positions. By focusing on capital efficiency and high loan-to-value ratios, the protocol provides a robust borrowing experience. As part of the Mantle ecosystem, Aurelius Finance empowers users to maximize the utility of their holdings through secure lending infrastructure.
